title: Business Central’s New API Overview: A Modern Replacement for Web Services
summary: Business Central's new API Overview page provides a modern, unified interface to discover all API pages in your environment, replacing the legacy Web Services page. It displays versioned APIs with publisher/group/version hierarchy and represents Microsoft's shift away from SOAP and legacy OData toward AL-defined APIs.
key_points: API Overview is a system page that lists all API pages regardless of source with metadata including entity name, publisher, version, page ID, and OData URL
The page supports full API versioning and publisher/group/version hierarchy, unlike the Web Services page which had no versioning or grouping
SOAP endpoints are deprecated and OData is legacy; AL-defined APIs are the future direction Microsoft is moving toward
Provides better discoverability and onboarding for developers without requiring manual publishing or external documentation

quotes.text: With the introduction of the API Overview, Business Central finally provides a modern, unified way to see all API pages exposed in your environment.
quotes.why_it_matters: This explains the core benefit of the new feature as a centralized discovery mechanism for all APIs in an environment.

quotes.text: SOAP is deprecated. OData is legacy. AL‑defined APIs are the future.
quotes.why_it_matters: This clarifies Microsoft's strategic direction and why the shift away from Web Services to API Overview matters for developers.

quotes.text: The API Overview gives you a structured, modern look at your API surface.
quotes.why_it_matters: This highlights the modernization aspect and how the page provides organized, authoritative information about available APIs.
